notes: Evidence class is host-level test plus code-level verification; no virtual-device or hardware run was possible on this host.
The driver source is compiled unchanged; time and delayed work are simulated by the harness, so absolute timings are model timings.
Both residual points from the second round are closed in code and exercised in the harness; no new residual path was found.
Open question for the author: the pasted log shows the next boot ~19 s after the S+U remount line, while the new poll should restart ~1.7 s later; asked for journalctl -b -1 -o short-monotonic.
An inherent <=200 ms window remains between the last .shutdown sample and the halt; not a code request.
